description: This file contains build and deployment scripts for runtime assets in a software project, including definitions for static assets, functions for copying assets, and alias management during post-build steps.

methods.name: listStaticExtensionAssetOutputs
methods.description: Returns the list of output destination paths for static extension assets, sorted alphabetically.

methods.name: copyStaticExtensionAssets
methods.description: Copies specified static assets from source to destination, creating directories as needed, and warns if assets are missing.

methods.name: writeStableRootRuntimeAliases
methods.description: Generates alias files in the distribution directory for runtime assets matching a specific pattern.

methods.name: runRuntimePostBuild
methods.description: Executes the sequence of post-build steps including copying plugins, writing catalogs, staging runtime, and copying static assets.
